title: One-hour repeated-forcing FMC persistence comparator
purpose: Test whether the admitted FMC surface-plus-fixed-water-table advantage over R2 persists for one hour under repeated changes in prescribed infiltrating flux, without changing any D12-D19 process law.

predecessor_authority.D16: Surface infiltration/redistribution branch retained research candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D17: Simultaneous separated surface+groundwater operation retained research candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D19: Exact-contact merge plus post-merge groundwater relaxation retained research candidacy.
predecessor_authority.implication: D20 introduces no new front, slug, groundwater or merge equations. It extends only duration and forcing order while remaining inside the separated continuous-infiltration branch.

initial_state.surface_component: D16 I_DEEP connected fronts: z_101=120 cm linearly to z_199=10 cm
initial_state.groundwater_component: D13 G25: H_j=0.25*abs(psi(theta_j)) above fixed water table at 160 cm
initial_state.mapping: exact finite-volume cell averages to R16/R2

matched_boundaries.top: prescribed infiltrating flux q_in=factor*Ksat; native SWAP top_flux=-q_in
matched_boundaries.bottom: fixed zero pressure head / fixed water table at z=160 cm

per_step: reserve K(theta_i)*dt gray-bin direct throughflow from top supply
allocate all remaining supply to already connected D17 surface fronts with D15 left-to-right finite-volume accounting and D14 Eq.18 kinematics
advance D13 groundwater fronts by Eq.21 and conservative relaxation
bottom outward exchange = gray direct throughflow - groundwater-front storage change
require connected surface and groundwater intervals remain strictly separated

checks: all four histories complete 360 FMC steps
every step has surface supply >= gray-bin demand
all residual surface supply is absorbed by already connected fronts
no dry-bin activation, ponding or runoff
all front states finite and physical
all histories have identical cumulative prescribed top input
internal_preflight_before_SWAP.failure_rule: Any failure closes D20 before R16/R2 trajectory generation. Do not retune factor order, block duration, total duration, G25 lambda, bins, process step or equations.

SWAP_comparators.numerical_authority: D4 integrated-water-depth strict-first research policy; hard accepted transaction mass gate 1e-12 cm

persistence_diagnostics: absolute error at each block boundary

positive_rule: internal preflight passes before SWAP exposure
all four R16/R2/FMC histories complete with integrity
full-hour FMC bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 and sign errors <= R2
late-window FMC total-storage, cumulative-bottom-exchange, mapped-theta and bottom-flux RMSE each <= R2

purpose_boundary.LONG_TERM_REGIONAL_WATER_BALANCE: D20 is only a one-hour hydraulic persistence discriminator; positive result may justify longer/application-specific validation but not acceptance.
purpose_boundary.GROUNDWATER_COUPLED_MANY_COLUMN: Fixed-water-table exchange only; live coupling remains separate.

successor_logic.if_positive: Retain FMC for a rainfall/ponding threshold workunit and permit a separate same-runtime screening experiment; application acceptance remains deferred.
successor_logic.if_negative: Do not retune D12-D19 physics. Diagnose persistence failure and restrict FMC to shorter bounded envelopes.
successor_logic.if_preflight_fails: Move next to a separately preregistered rainfall/ponding or contact-capable persistence design; do not alter D20.
